newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Refugio gold mine may reopen mid-week.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Refugio gold mine may reopen mid-week.

text.p: Roads to Chile's Refugio gold mine have been reopened after being blocked by heavy snow for over three weeks and the pit could start operating again mid-week, said an official at the mine.

"Roads have been reopened and the first workers were taken up to the mine today," said human resources managers Anibal Avendano from mine headquarters at Copaipo. "Conditions at the mine should start to normalize by the middle of the week."
The gold mine was closed last month after blizzards dumped meters of snow over the open-cast pit and access roads to the mine high in the Andes near the border with Agentina.
Rufugio is owned equally by Bema Gold Corp and Amax Gold. It produces around 230,000 ounces of gold a year.
